update_scope: Public test identifiers and case directories were renamed. All affected RTL and separate Spike inputs were rebuilt and rerun. Production RTL and expected-value rules are unchanged.
command_format: Recorded arguments with build, ELF and limit-file paths replaced by documented variables. Each call has a separate writable run directory.
data_blob_format: Keys are SHA256 values of actual one-u32-per-line exports. Reconstruct sparse entries with the stated default, then format each u32 as eight lowercase hex digits and a newline. Unknown words, if any, are preserved literally and never accepted as complete data.

variants.ML: Combined local mask-unit and lane method
variants.J: Combined local index-EEW, segment-decode, and mask fixes

implementation_checks.status: Previously accepted frozen-input generic checks reused
implementation_checks.scope: Real-module compile -no_map structural checks only. No technology mapping, timing closure, or physical signoff.
implementation_checks.reuse_scope: Earlier accepted generic checks reused for byte-identical production RTL, packages and wrapper types. No new DC invocation. Public environment-variable labels changed only.

scope: Segment-generated internal starts with architectural vstart=0. No architectural nonzero-vstart/fault restart or other lane/VLEN claims.

previous_public_failure_records.first_O_L_runs: All eight original 20ms cutoffs lacked scheduled deadline snapshots. Their checker rejections and raw data remain retained.
previous_public_failure_records.deadline_fix: VCS minimal TB confirms that run 0 ns processes the same timestamp after run 20 ms. Only the eight incomplete O/L diagnostics reran. No DUT, observer, ELF, or checker changed.

retained_failure_scope: Original wrong-FENCE rejection with 2004 late byte writes, first deadline-snapshot failures, and earlier raw inputs remain in the previous public commit and the original evidence archive. They are not relabelled as new passes.
